notes:
## Changelog
### Fixed
- Fixed updater can loop forever and never relaunch.
- Fixed layout picker can delete bundled presets.
- Fixed Holding "X" bypasses the two-press delete check and spams strips.
- Fixed  "Esc" closes the whole Strip Layout Editor.
- Fixed reconnect loses offline edits and strips.
- Fixed restore autosave scrambles the board and crashes on a bad file.
- Fixed loading a layout silently wipes the board.
- Fixed “Apply” layout shares live objects with the editor.
- Fixed updates install even when verification is skipped.
- Fixed “Set Default” on a preset doesn’t survive a restart in onefile builds.
- Fixed Upper-casing fields is inconsistent.
- Fixed "bulk add" inconsistencies.
- Fixed breakout can hand out 7500/7600/7700 or duplicate squawks.
- Fixed host beeps for transfers addressed to someone else.
- Fixed disconnected client sockets are never freed.
- Fixed two clients with the same controller name flap forever.
- Fixed cancelling a connection attempt can still connect.
- Fixed non-editable combo editors never close.
- Fixed strip widgets can be left on screen after delete, breakout or collapse.
- Fixed two info blocks with the same identifier don’t sync locally.

### Changed
- Strips dropdown items font now sizes correctly.
- General code cleanup.
